verdict.rationale: Kong documents a dedicated AI Semantic Cache plugin, and its semantic-similarity docs say AI Gateway can cache responses using similarity queries, so repeated or similar requests can be served at the gateway. The evidence is mostly plugin titles and one-line feature statements rather than detailed configuration or measured results. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost and latency savings from cache hits, cache configuration details (TTL, exact-match vs semantic, vector store backends), independent or hands-on corroboration.
